changelog:
Shopdora Shopee Tool v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Enables cross-border e-commerce data analysis on all Shopee sites (keyword/product/review/category/balance).
- Requires user API credentials; provides setup instructions and guides for missing information.
- Automatic site code mapping and structured pre-call user confirmation to prevent wasted quota.
- Implements 24-hour local caching for paid endpoint queries to minimize redundant quota consumption.
- Strict result/failure handling: no auto-retries or parameter changes without user confirmation.
- Workflow structured for secure credential/token management, cached results, and clear user prompts.
